**What this changes and why**

**Gate** (all must pass locally)
- [ ] `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] `pnpm build` in `apps/desktop`

**AI assistance**
AI-assisted contributions are welcome here (much of Tracon is agent-written).
Two asks: you have reviewed every line yourself, and you say so below.

- [ ] Written by hand / [ ] AI-assisted and human-reviewed
